pageCache.pageTitle: West Drayton Academy - Ethos and Values
pageCache.text:
Ethos and Values
We want our children to love school. We want to provide our pupils with a range of learning experiences, both within & beyond the classroom, which inspires them and helps to shape their futures; helping them to become responsible citizens of the future.
What are Values?
Values are important to guide us to behave in a certain way. We believe in our values and they help us to know how to act so that we can work towards fulfilling our dreams. Our values help us know what is right and wrong.
Why are our values important to us?
West Drayton’s values are called 'The Four Pillars' and they thread through the curriculum. Our values articulate the moral and academic expectations for all.
Ethos and Values

pageCache.pageTitle: West Drayton Academy - Welcome to WDA
pageCache.text:
Welcome to WDA
On behalf of the children, staff and governors it is with great pleasure that we welcome you to West Drayton Academy.
West Drayton Academy is a large three form entry primary school serving a vibrant, supportive and diverse community. We are proud to be part of the Park Federation Trust. The Trust is one of the longest established and most experienced primary federations in the country with nine schools in Slough, Hillingdon and now Buckinghamshire.
In addition to learning excellence, we also aim to develop the personal qualities that will allow the children to leave our school ready to make a positive contribution to society. We understand that being successful is often about attitude and the ability to work hard - we aim to instil those qualities in our pupils.
Here at West Drayton Academy, we believe that the combination of our 'SKIP' curriculum and 'Four Pillars' values provides the skills, knowledge and opportunities that will help to prepare our children for today and beyond.
Our pupils are energetic, respectful and grateful. Parents are supportive and recognize that we are a team around their child.
We look forward to welcoming you to our WDA family where we proudly demonstrate: Believe, Empower, Achieve. We believe that our young people are capable of excellence.
Welcome to WDA

British Values
In accordance with The Department for Education we aim to actively promote British values in schools to ensure young people leave school prepared for life in modern Britain.
Click here for more information on British Values at West Drayton Academy.

Reading
Reading is an entitlement of every child. We believe teaching every child to read well, making time within the school day to read, and embedding a culture of reading will make a profound difference to children’s lives!
Reading is at the heart of our curriculum. Within all subjects, we are committed to promoting a love for reading. Opportunities to read are cherished. Children are confident, fluent readers who develop a broad range of reading skills. Pupils are constantly exposed to new vocabulary to improve articulation and comprehension.
Reading promotes a better understanding of the world. Understanding people, places and events increases knowledge and provides opportunities for children to apply knowledge.
Click the link below to find out about reading at West Drayton. This document includes our reading overview, reading skills, progression by year group and reading expectations by year group.
